mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 showed sustained growth over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) both increase by more than 5% in a month, it signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate potential monetary tightening and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL showed sustained growth over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase simultaneously in a month, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic activity.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased and PAYEMS increased in the prior month.
